logline: A compassionate guard secretly feeds Juliana bread in the dungeon, strengthening her resolve to protect Alexander's secrets just as distant wedding bells signal the start of Rupert's nuptials and her impending execution.
continuity_notes: Following Rupert and Catherine's cruel announcement pairing their wedding with Juliana's public execution, Juliana remains starved in the subterranean dungeon awaiting her fate.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile shot of Juliana slumped on the damp stone floor of her dark dungeon cell, her wrists bound in heavy iron shackles and chains draped over her lap.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana sits motionless against the cold masonry, weak and visibly drained from starvation, her eyes cast downward.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Echoing, heavy bootsteps approach down the corridor outside the cell.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Juliana's profile as her head turns toward the corridor, her blue eyes widening with cautious alarm.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana blinks, lifting her gaze toward the heavy iron bars.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot through the cell bars as a Guard in a black collared uniform with silver buttons halts outside.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Guard pauses, glancing over his shoulder into the gloomy corridor to ensure he is unobserved.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot focusing on the wet flagstones at the base of the cell door.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Guard kneels down and slips a small loaf of rustic bread through the bottom gap between the iron bars, nudging it inside before withdrawing his gloved hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling forward across the stone floor toward the bread, her gaze fixed on the offering in disbelief.

segments.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Bewildered)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Why?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Guard looking through the vertical bars with quiet compassion.

segments.label: GUARD (Subdued, Sincere)
segments.speaker: GUARD
segments.text: Because no one should die hungry.

segments.label: GUARD (Urgent, Whispered)
segments.speaker: GUARD
segments.text: Eat it before they see.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot through the cell bars as the Guard turns and walks swiftly away into the dark corridor.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Guard's silhouette retreats into the shadows.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight shot following Juliana's trembling, shackle-bound hands as she reaches out and drags the loaf toward her chest.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana clutches the bread tightly with both hands, tears welling in her eyes.

segments.label: JULIANA (Choked Up, Tearful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of Juliana chewing the bread, tears rolling down her soot-streaked cheek.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.

segments.label: JULIANA (Sorrowful, Whispering)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle wide shot of Juliana seated against the damp stone wall beneath high overhead iron ceiling grates, clutching the half-eaten bread in her lap.

segments.label: JULIANA (Yearning)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: ...are you safe?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Intimate close-up of Juliana looking upward, her tear-stained face filled with raw anguish.

segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Trembling)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Do you even know what happened to me?

segments.label: JULIANA (Grief-Stricken)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Do you know they condemned me?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight macro shot on Juliana's chin and throat as she presses a trembling hand against her chest.

segments.label: JULIANA (Fearful, Pleading)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: What if I die here?

segments.label: JULIANA (Heartbroken)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: What if I never see you again?

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up profile of Juliana closing her eyes, drawing a deep breath to steady herself.

segments.label: JULIANA (Fervent Prayer)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Keep him safe.

segments.label: JULIANA (Resigned)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Wherever he is.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Frontal medium shot of Juliana kneeling upright, her right hand pressed firmly over her heart, her posture transforming into quiet dignity.

segments.label: JULIANA (Determined)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Let him live.

segments.label: JULIANA (Steely)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: And if I have only one thing left to give...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.

segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Unshakable)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I will not give them my husband.

segments.label: JULIANA (Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I will not betray him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's closed eyelids as she takes a sharp, startled breath.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.

segments.label: JULIANA (Startled Whisper)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Bells.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot as Juliana scrambles to her feet, chains clinking loudly against her skirts.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.

segments.label: JULIANA (Realizing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: The wedding.

segments.label: JULIANA (Grim)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It's beginning.

segments.label: JULIANA (Somber, Steely)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Then I suppose I'm next.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up between the vertical iron bars framed directly on Juliana's face. The terror in her eyes softens into an unexpected, brave smile of enduring faith.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.

segments.label: JULIANA (Hopeful, Tender)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Dramatic cut to black.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.
